name: Interim
source: A psychological horror visual novel about a breakup you can't stop rewriting in your head. You play as a night-shift convenience store clerk, trying to leave the past behind. But... something is wrong with this dystopian city. Or something is wrong with you. Every strange encounter could be explained away, yet you just can't seem to do it.
translation: 一部关于分手的心理恐怖视觉小说，你会忍不住在脑海中重写。你扮演一名夜班便利店店员，试图将过去抛在脑后。但是……这座反乌托邦城市有些不对劲。或者你有什么问题。每一次奇怪的遭遇都可以解释，但你似乎做不到。
